en.s: On 31 January 1206, Bulgarian forces defeated a Latin Empire army near Rusion, in present-day Turkey. The Latin troops had left their fortress the previous evening.

zh.s: 1206年1月31日，保加利亚军队在今土耳其境内的鲁西翁附近击败拉丁帝国军队。拉丁军队此前一晚离开了堡垒。

en.s: The Battle of Lena occurred on January 31, 1208, and probably took place near Kungslena (58°14′N 13°50′E / 58.233°N 13.833°E), which is located in the Tidaholm Municipality in Västergötland, Sweden. It was an important battle between the Danish-backed former Swedish King Sverker II of Sweden and Prince Eric. Danish King Valdemar the Victorious provided Sverker with a large army; medieval sources estimate the size of the force at 12,000 to 18,000. The defending Swedish force numbered between 7,000 and 10,000, and were additionally backed up by a small number of Norwegian auxiliaries. The Swedes won, according to legend aided by Odin, and Sverker fled to Denmark.

zh.s: 莱纳战役发生于1208年1月31日，地点很可能在瑞典西约特兰蒂达霍尔姆市镇的孔斯莱纳附近，约北纬58°14′、东经13°50′。这场重要战役的双方，是得到丹麦支持的瑞典前国王斯韦尔克尔二世和埃里克王子。丹麦国王“胜利者”瓦尔德马向斯韦尔克尔提供大军，中世纪史料估计人数为12000至18000人。瑞典守军约7000至10000人，另有少量挪威辅助部队。瑞典军获胜，传说他们得到奥丁相助，斯韦尔克尔则逃往丹麦。

en.s: The Mudéjar revolt of 1264–1266 was a rebellion by the Muslim populations (Mudéjares) in the Lower Andalusia and Murcia regions of the Crown of Castile. The rebellion was in response to Castile's policy of relocating Muslim populations from these regions and was partially instigated by Muhammad I of Granada. The rebels were aided by the independent Emirate of Granada, while the Castilians were allied with Aragon.
en.n: The Mudéjar of Murcia, who had rebelled against the Crown of Castile during the Mudéjar revolt of 1264–1266, surrender the city to James I of Aragon after a siege lasting a month.

zh.s: 1264至1266年的穆德哈尔起义，是卡斯蒂利亚王权统治下下安达卢西亚和穆尔西亚地区的穆斯林居民发动的叛乱。卡斯蒂利亚推行迁徙政策，强迫当地穆斯林离开这些地区，引发了起义；格拉纳达统治者穆罕默德一世也在一定程度上推动了叛乱。独立的格拉纳达埃米尔国援助起义者，卡斯蒂利亚则与阿拉贡结盟。穆尔西亚的穆德哈尔人此前反抗卡斯蒂利亚，围城一个月后于1月31日向阿拉贡的海梅一世交出该城。
zh.n: 卡斯蒂利亚—阿拉贡战争：穆德哈尔起义中，穆尔西亚的穆德哈尔人在被围困一个月后向阿拉贡的海梅一世交出该城。

en.s: The siege of Malacca occurred in 1575, when the Sultan of Aceh attacked the Portuguese city of Malacca. The Catholic forces resisted the attack and the Muslims were routed.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1575年，亚齐苏丹进攻葡萄牙控制的马六甲城。天主教军队抵挡住攻势，穆斯林军队被击退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Spanish forces win the Battle of Gembloux
en.s: On 31 January 1578, Spanish forces led by Don John of Austria defeated the Netherlandish rebel army at Gembloux, in present-day Belgium, during the Eighty Years’ War.

zh.t: 西班牙军队赢得让布卢战役
zh.s: 1578年1月31日，八十年战争期间，奥地利的唐胡安率领西班牙军队，在今比利时让布卢击败尼德兰起义军。

en.s: Guy Fawkes (; 13 April 1570 – 31 January 1606), also known as Guido Fawkes while fighting for the Spanish, was a member of a group of provincial English Catholics involved in the failed Gunpowder Plot of 1605. He was born and educated in York; his father died when Fawkes was eight years old, after which his mother married a recusant Catholic.

zh.s: 盖伊·福克斯（1570年4月13日—1606年1月31日）在为西班牙效力期间也称圭多·福克斯。他是参与1605年火药阴谋的一群英格兰地方天主教徒之一。福克斯在约克出生并在那里接受教育；他八岁时父亲去世，母亲随后嫁给了一名拒绝改信英国国教的天主教徒。

en.s: The Bank of Amsterdam or Wisselbank (Dutch: Amsterdamsche Wisselbank, lit. 'Exchange Bank of Amsterdam') was an early bank, vouched for by the city of Amsterdam, and established in 1609. It was the first public bank to offer accounts not directly convertible to coin. As such, it has been described by some as the first true central bank, even though that view is not uniformly shared.

zh.t: 阿姆斯特丹汇兑银行成立
zh.s: 阿姆斯特丹银行（荷兰语：Amsterdamsche Wisselbank，意为“阿姆斯特丹汇兑银行”）是早期银行，由阿姆斯特丹市担保，于1609年成立。它是首家提供账户、且账户余额不能直接兑换成硬币的公立银行。因此有人称它为第一家真正的中央银行，但对此说法并无一致看法。

en.s: The Action of 31 January 1748 was a minor naval battle of the War of Austrian Succession between two British Royal naval ships and a French naval ship of the line. The battle ended with the capture of the French ship of the line Le Magnanime. In January 1748, Le Magnanime left Brest for the East Indies. She was partially dismasted in a storm off the coast of Ushant and while limping back to Brest, she was spotted by a British fleet under Edward Hawke.

zh.s: 1748年1月31日海战是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场小规模海战，两艘英国皇家海军舰艇与法国战列舰“宽宏”号交战，最终俘获该舰。1748年1月，“宽宏”号从布雷斯特驶往东印度群岛，在韦桑岛外海风暴中部分桅杆折断。它艰难返航布雷斯特途中，被爱德华·霍克率领的英国舰队发现。

en.s: The action of 31 January 1779 was a naval engagement that took place off the coast of Brittany during the American Revolutionary War between a Royal Navy frigate HMS Apollo and the French Navy frigate Oiseau. The action resulted in the British capture of the French vessel.

zh.s: 1779年1月31日，美国独立战争期间，英国皇家海军“阿波罗”号护卫舰与法国海军“飞鸟”号护卫舰在布列塔尼外海交战，最终英军俘获法国舰艇。

en.s: The 1782 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on January 31, 1782, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Candidate and former Speaker of the South Carolina House of Representatives John Mathews was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly after their initial choice Christopher Gadsden declined to take the office. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 1782年1月31日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。州议会最初选中的克里斯托弗·加兹登拒绝就任，随后选出前州众议院议长约翰·马修斯担任州长。本次选举的确切票数不详。

en.s: The 1783 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on January 31, 1783, in order to elect the Governor of South Carolina. Candidate and incumbent member of the South Carolina House of Representatives Benjamin Guerard was elected by the South Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 1783年1月31日，南卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。时任州众议员本杰明·盖拉德在没有竞争对手的情况下，由州议会选为州长。本次选举的确切票数不详。

en.s: Hong Kyŏngnae's Rebellion (Korean: 홍경래의 난; Hanja: 洪景來의 亂) was a peasant revolt that occurred between 31 January 1812 and 29 May 1812 in Joseon. It was led by Hong Kyŏngnae and the upperclass yangban of Pyeongan Province, who were unhappy with a tax regime based on government-administered high-interest loans. Impoverished farmers joined them following a year of exceptionally poor harvest, when they were forced nonetheless to contribute to a "grain fund".

zh.s: 洪景来起义是朝鲜王朝的一场农民起义，发生于1812年1月31日至5月29日。起义由洪景来和平安道两班上层人士领导，他们不满政府通过高息贷款征税。前一年庄稼歉收，贫困农民即使收成很差仍被迫缴纳“粮食基金”，于是也加入了起义。

en.s: On 31 January 1846, the city of Milwaukee was formed in Wisconsin, United States, after the previous year’s bridge dispute between its settlements.

zh.s: 1846年1月31日，美国威斯康星的密尔沃基正式建市。在此前一年，当地几个聚落曾因修桥发生冲突。

en.t: Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Thirteenth Amendment (Amendment XIII) to the United States Constitution made slavery and involuntary servitude illegal, except as punishment for a crime. The amendment was passed by the Senate on April 8, 1864, by the House of Representatives on January 31, 1865, and ratified by the required 27 of the then 36 states on December 6, 1865, and proclaimed on December 18, 1865.
en.n: American Civil War: The United States Congress passes the Thirteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, abolishing slavery, and submits it to the states for ratification.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十三修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十三修正案废除了奴隶制和非自愿奴役，但对犯罪惩罚的情形除外。修正案于1864年4月8日在参议院通过，1865年1月31日在众议院通过，随后于1865年12月6日获得当时36个州中27个州批准，并于同年12月18日正式公布。
zh.n: 美国内战：美国国会通过宪法第十三修正案，废除奴隶制，并将修正案提交各州批准。

en.t: Confederate Senate confirms Lee as general-in-chief
en.s: On January 31, 1865, the Confederate Senate confirmed President Jefferson Davis’s nomination of Robert E. Lee as general-in-chief of the Confederate armies during the American Civil War. Lee’s formal assumption of command followed in February.
en.n: This records the Senate’s January 31 confirmation, distinct from the February appointment and command orders.

zh.t: 邦联参议院确认李将军的总司令提名
zh.s: 1865年1月31日，美国内战期间，邦联参议院确认总统杰斐逊·戴维斯提名罗伯特·E·李担任各军总司令。李于2月正式接掌这一职务。
zh.n: 此条记录1月31日参议院的确认，区别于2月的任命及接掌指挥权。

en.s: The Battle of Pehuajó, also known as Battle of Corrales or Battle of Itati was fought during the Paraguayan War in January 31, 1866. Around 1,500 Paraguayan troops commanded by General Francisco Isidoro Resquín and Lieutenant Celestino Prieto engaged in a surprise attack against a couple of advanced Argentine and Uruguayan battalions with about 2,000 men led by General Emilio Conesa, under direct command of the president of Argentina, Bartolomé Mitre.

zh.s: 佩瓦霍战役又称科拉莱斯战役或伊塔蒂战役，发生于巴拉圭战争期间的1866年1月31日。弗朗西斯科·伊西多罗·雷斯金将军和塞莱斯蒂诺·普列托中尉指挥约1500名巴拉圭士兵，突袭了阿根廷和乌拉圭军的数个前出营。被袭部队约2000人，由埃米利奥·科内萨将军率领，直接受阿根廷总统巴托洛梅·米特雷指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Toba–Fushimi (鳥羽・伏見の戦い, Toba-Fushimi no Tatakai) occurred between pro-Imperial and Tokugawa shogunate forces during the Boshin War in Japan. The battle started on 27 January 1868 (or fourth year of Keiō, first month, 3rd day, according to the lunar calendar), when the forces of the shogunate and the allied forces of Chōshū, Satsuma and Tosa Domains clashed near Fushimi, a town near Kyoto, the sacred capital, and fighting progressed to the Toba road leading to Osaka, with the initial rout of the Satsuma from Fushimi.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鸟羽伏见之战（日语：鳥羽・伏見の戦い，罗马字：Toba-Fushimi no Tatakai）是日本戊辰战争期间倒幕派与德川幕府军队之间的战斗。战斗于1868年1月27日（庆应四年正月初三）打响，幕府军与长州、萨摩、土佐藩联军在京都附近的伏见交战，战事随后沿通往大阪的鸟羽街道展开，萨摩军一度溃退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Amoaful was fought on 31 January 1874 during the Third Anglo-Ashanti War when Sir Garnet Wolseley defeated the Ashantis after strong resistance. The attack was led by the 42nd Regiment of Foot. At Amoaful, one combat post-mortem pays tribute to the Ashanti commander: "The great Chief Amanquatia was among the killed.

zh.s: 阿莫阿富尔战役发生于1874年1月31日，属于第三次英阿散蒂战争。加内特·沃尔斯利爵士击败了顽强抵抗的阿散蒂人。英军由第42步兵团率先发动进攻。一段战后记录称赞阿散蒂指挥官：“伟大的首领阿曼夸蒂亚也在阵亡者之列。”

en.s: The Battle of Vranje, or the Liberation of Vranje (Serbian: Ослобођење Врања / Oslobođenje Vranja), represented one of the final stages of the second phase of the Serbian–Ottoman War (1876–78). At the beginning of the war, the Serbian army began the offensive in what is today South Serbia. After the Battle of Grdelicaа, the Serbian army managed to break into the Masurica Valley leaving the road to Vranje open and unguarded.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 弗拉涅战役又称“解放弗拉涅”，是1876至1878年第二次塞土战争第二阶段的最后几场战役之一。战争初期，塞尔维亚军队在今天的塞尔维亚南部发动攻势。格尔德利察战役后，塞军进入马苏里察山谷，通往弗拉涅的道路因此畅通，守备力量薄弱。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 31 January 1891 revolt was the first attempt by republicans to overthrow the monarchy in Portugal. The revolt took place in the form of a military uprising in the country's second city of Porto.

zh.s: 1891年1月31日起义是葡萄牙共和派首次试图推翻君主制的行动，以军事起义的形式发生在该国第二大城市波尔图。

en.t: Chekhov’s Three Sisters premieres in Moscow
en.s: On 31 January 1901, Anton Chekhov’s Three Sisters opened at the Moscow Art Theatre in Russia, directed by Konstantin Stanislavski and Vladimir Nemirovich-Danchenko.

zh.t: 契诃夫《三姐妹》在莫斯科首演
zh.s: 1901年1月31日，契诃夫的话剧《三姐妹》在俄罗斯莫斯科艺术剧院首演，由康斯坦丁·斯坦尼斯拉夫斯基和弗拉基米尔·涅米罗维奇-丹钦科执导。

en.s: On January 31, 1915, German forces used artillery shells containing tear gas against Russian troops near Bolimów, in present-day Poland, during the First World War.
en.n: This records the dated gas-shell attack, not the whole multi-week Battle of Humin-Bolimów.

zh.t: 德军在博利莫夫使用毒气弹
zh.s: 1915年1月31日，第一次世界大战期间，德军在今波兰博利莫夫附近向俄军发射装有催泪性毒气的炮弹。
zh.n: 此条记录当天的毒气弹攻击，区别于持续数周的胡明—博利莫夫战役。

en.t: Suinula massacre during the Finnish Civil War
en.s: On 31 January 1918, surrendered White Guards were shot at Suinula in Kangasala, Finland, during the Finnish Civil War. The shooting killed and wounded members of the surrendered group.

zh.t: 芬兰内战期间发生苏伊努拉屠杀
zh.s: 1918年1月31日，芬兰内战期间，一批已经投降的白卫军人员在坎加萨拉的苏伊努拉遭到枪击，多人死伤。

en.s: The Battle of May Island is the name given to the series of accidents that occurred during Operation E.C.1 in 1918. Named after the Isle of May, a nearby island in the Firth of Forth, the "battle" consisted of a disastrous series of accidents amongst Royal Navy vessels on their way from Rosyth, Scotland, to fleet exercises in the North Sea.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “五月岛海战”是对1918年E.C.1行动期间一系列事故的统称。事件以附近福斯湾的五月岛命名，事故发生在英国皇家海军舰艇从苏格兰罗斯赛斯驶往北海参加舰队演习途中，造成严重损失。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Paju (Estonian: Paju lahing) was fought in Paju, near Valga, Estonia, on 31 January 1919 during the Estonian War of Independence. After heavy fighting, the Tartu-Valga group of the Estonian Army pushed the Red Latvian Riflemen out of the Paju Manor. It was the fiercest battle in the early period of war. Estonian commander Julius Kuperjanov fell in the fighting.

zh.s: 1919年1月31日，爱沙尼亚独立战争期间，双方在瓦尔加附近的帕尤交战。经过激战，爱沙尼亚陆军塔尔图—瓦尔加部队将拉脱维亚红色步枪兵逐出帕尤庄园。这是战争初期最激烈的一场战斗，爱沙尼亚指挥官尤利乌斯·库佩尔亚诺夫在战斗中倒下。

en.s: The Ashton-under-Lyne by-election, 1920 was a by-election held on 31 January 1920 for the British House of Commons constituency of Ashton-under-Lyne. The by-election was triggered by the elevation to the peerage of the town's Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP) Albert Stanley, who was ennobled as Baron Ashfield. The result was a victory for the Conservative candidate Sir Walter de Frece, who held the seat with a massively reduced majority. British Pathe has a newsreel clip of Sir Walter Frece campaigning in the by-election with his wife.

zh.t: 1920年阿什顿安德莱恩选区补选
zh.s: 英国下议院阿什顿安德莱恩选区于1920年1月31日举行补选。该区保守党议员阿尔伯特·斯坦利获封阿什菲尔德男爵、进入贵族院，因而触发补选。保守党候选人沃尔特·德·弗里斯爵士获胜，保住议席，但领先票数大幅减少。英国百代保存有他与妻子一同参加补选竞选活动的新闻影片。

en.s: The West Siberian rebellion was the largest of the Russian peasant uprisings against the nascent Bolshevik state. It began in early 1921 and was defeated at the end of 1922, due in part to the brutal repression of the militarily superior Red Army, and the famine that the region suffered.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西西伯利亚起义是新生布尔什维克政权面对的规模最大的一场俄国农民起义。起义于1921年初爆发，到1922年底被镇压，原因之一是军事力量占优的红军进行残酷镇压，此外当地饥荒也加剧了局势。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1925 Albanian presidential election marked the first presidential election held on 31 January 1925 in Albania, electing the first president of Albania. The incumbent prime minister Ahmet Zogu won the election in a vote conducted by the parliament of Albania. Zogu was sworn in for his first seven-year term on 1 February 1925. It marked the first and last presidential election before Zogu was proclaimed the King of Albania on 1 September 1928.

zh.s: 阿尔巴尼亚于1925年1月31日举行首次总统选举，由议会选出该国首位总统。现任总理艾哈迈德·索古获胜，于2月1日宣誓就任，开始第一个七年任期。这也是索古在1928年9月1日被宣布为阿尔巴尼亚国王之前，唯一的一次总统选举。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Parkes on 31 January 1931. This was triggered by the resignation of Labor MP Edward McTiernan to take a seat on the High Court. The by-election was won by Nationalist candidate Charles Marr, who had represented the seat from 1919 until his defeat by McTiernan in 1929.

zh.s: 1931年1月31日，澳大利亚众议院帕克斯选区举行补选。工党议员爱德华·麦克蒂尔南辞职出任高等法院法官，因此触发补选。民族党候选人查尔斯·马尔获胜；他曾于1919年至1929年代表该选区，之后败给麦克蒂尔南。

en.s: The Attack on Convoy AN 14 was a naval engagement during World War II between a British naval force defending a convoy of merchant ships, which had departed from Port Said and Alexandria to Piraeus and two Italian torpedo boats who intercepted them north of Crete on 31 January 1941. The Italian vessels, Lupo and Libra, launched two torpedoes each. The torpedoes fired by Libra missed their target but one from Lupo hit and disabled for the rest of the war the 8,120 long tons (8,250 t) British tanker Desmoulea which had to be towed to Suda Bay in Crete and beached.

zh.s: 1941年1月31日，二战期间，英国海军护送一支从塞得港和亚历山大港驶往比雷埃夫斯的商船队，在克里特岛以北遭两艘意大利鱼雷艇拦截。“狼”号和“天秤”号各发射两枚鱼雷。“天秤”号发射的鱼雷未命中，但“狼”号的一枚鱼雷击中8120长吨（8250公吨）的英国油轮“德斯穆利亚”号，使其在此后整个战争期间无法投入使用。油轮被拖到克里特岛苏达湾搁滩。

en.s: The Battle of Agordat was fought near Agordat in Eritrea from 26 to 31 January 1941, by the Italian army and Royal Corps of Colonial Troops against British, Commonwealth and Indian forces, during the East African Campaign of the Second World War. The British had the advantage of breaking Italian codes and cyphers before the offensive and received copious amounts of information from Italian sources on the order of battle and plans of the Regia Aeronautica (Italian Royal Air Force) and the Italian army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1941年1月26日至31日，意大利军队和殖民地军团与英国、英联邦及印度部队在厄立特里亚阿戈尔达特附近交战。这场战斗属于第二次世界大战东非战役。进攻前，英军破译了意大利密码，并从意方获得大量关于皇家意大利空军和意军兵力部署及作战计划的情报。

en.s: The Barvenkovo–Lozovaya offensive was a Red Army operation on the Eastern Front in the European Theatre of World War II; it took place between 18 and 31 January 1942. The Red Army advanced 90–100 kilometres (56–62 mi) and destroyed 3 German divisions (298th, 68 and 257th Infantry Divisions). According to Soviet data, Nazi Germany lost 25,000 soldiers. According to German sources, some 5,000 soldiers were lost.

zh.t: 巴尔文科沃—洛佐瓦亚攻势
zh.s: 1942年1月18日至31日，苏联红军在二战欧洲东线发动巴尔文科沃—洛佐瓦亚攻势。红军推进90至100公里（56至62英里），摧毁德军第298、第68和第257步兵师。苏方资料称纳粹德国损失25000名士兵，德方资料则记载约损失5000人。

en.s: The Battle of the Shaggy Ridge was part of the Finisterre Range campaign, consisting of a number of actions fought by Australian and Japanese troops in Papua New Guinea in World War II. Following the Allied capture of Lae and Nadzab, the Australian 9th Division had been committed to a quick follow up action on the Huon Peninsula in an effort to cut off the withdrawing Japanese.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.t: Tom Morel assigned to collect RAF drops at Glières
en.s: On 31 January 1944, Lieutenant Tom Morel was assigned to collect Royal Air Force supply drops with 100 men on the Glières Plateau in France, as Resistance fighters gathered there.
en.n: This records Morel’s dated assignment, not the creation of all French Resistance activity or the later German assault.

zh.t: 汤姆·莫雷尔奉命在格利耶尔高原接收空投
zh.s: 1944年1月31日，汤姆·莫雷尔中尉奉命带领100人在法国格利耶尔高原接收英国皇家空军的物资空投，抵抗运动人员当时正在当地集结。
zh.n: 此条记录莫雷尔当天接到的任务，区别于法国抵抗运动的兴起和后来德军的进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Hill 170 was a battle between the British 3rd Commando Brigade and the Japanese 54th Division during the Second World War. The battle was fought in January 1945, as part of the Burma Campaign. The 3rd Commando Brigade were given the task of assaulting the Arakan Peninsula at Myebon. Here they were to take and hold the dominant features of the southern Chin Hills.
en.n: World War II: The end of fighting in the Battle of Hill 170 during the Burma Campaign, in which the British 3 Commando Brigade repulsed a Japanese counterattack on their positions and precipitated a general retirement from the Arakan Peninsula.

zh.s: 170高地战役是第二次世界大战期间英国第三突击旅与日本第54师之间的战斗。战斗于1945年1月在缅甸战役期间进行。第三突击旅奉命进攻阿拉干半岛的妙本，夺取并守住南钦山的制高点。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：缅甸战役期间，170高地战斗结束。英国第三突击旅击退日军反攻，迫使日军全面撤离阿拉干半岛。

en.s: The Battle for the Kapelsche Veer, also known as Operation Elephant took place between 26–31 January 1945. It was fought between the German Wehrmacht and allied troops at the Kapelsche Veer – a ferry crossing of the River Meuse near the village of Capelle in the province North Brabant of the Netherlands. The Wehrmacht had occupied the Netherlands since May 1940, having conquered the country during the Battle of France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡佩尔斯赫费尔战役又称“象行动”，发生于1945年1月26日至31日。德军与盟军在荷兰北布拉班特省卡佩尔斯赫费尔渡口交战。渡口位于默兹河上，靠近卡佩勒村。德军于1940年5月法国战役期间征服荷兰，此后一直占领该国。

en.t: US Army private Eddie Slovik is executed for desertion, the first such execution of an American soldier since the Civil War
en.s: Edward Donald Slovik (February 18, 1920 – January 31, 1945) was an American soldier who was court-martialed and executed for desertion during World War II. He was the only US serviceman to have met such a fate since the American Civil War, though in 1902, during the American-Philippine War, two American soldiers (Edmund DuBose and Lewis Russell) of the 9th Cavalry Regiment were executed for "desertion to the enemy".

zh.t: 美国陆军列兵埃迪·斯洛维克因逃兵罪被处决，是内战以来首位遭此处决的美国士兵
zh.s: 爱德华·唐纳德·斯洛维克（1920年2月18日—1945年1月31日）是一名美国士兵，因逃兵罪在第二次世界大战期间被军事法庭判刑并处决。自美国内战以来，他是唯一一名遭此处决的美国军人。不过，在1902年美菲战争期间，第9骑兵团的两名美国士兵埃德蒙·杜博斯和刘易斯·拉塞尔曾因“投敌逃亡”被处决。

en.s: The Karen conflict is an armed conflict in Kayin State, Myanmar (formerly known as Karen State, Burma). It is part of the wider internal conflict in Myanmar between the military government and various minority groups. Karen nationalists have been fighting for an independent state, known as Kawthoolei, since 1949. The Karen National Union (KNU) and its Karen National Liberation Army (KNLA) are the most prominent Karen rebel groups.

zh.s: 克伦冲突是发生在缅甸克耶邦（旧称克伦邦）的武装冲突，也是缅甸军政府与多个少数民族团体之间更大范围内战的一部分。克伦民族主义者自1949年起为建立名为“克瓦图莱”的独立国家而战。克伦民族联盟及其武装组织克伦民族解放军是最主要的克伦反叛组织。

en.s: The United Nations Security Council Resolution 90 was adopted by the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) on 31 January 1951. It resolved to remove the item "Complaint of aggression upon the Republic of Korea" from the list of matters of which the Council is seized.

en.s: The 1953 North Sea flood (Dutch: Watersnoodramp, literally "flood disaster") was a major flood caused by a heavy storm that occurred on the night of Saturday, 31 January 1953 and morning of Sunday, 1 February 1953. The floods struck the Netherlands, Belgium, England and Scotland. A combination of a high spring tide and a severe European windstorm over the North Sea caused a storm tide; the combination of wind, high tide, and low pressure led to a water level of more than 5.6 metres (18.4 ft) above mean sea level in some locations. The flood and waves overwhelmed sea defences and caused extensive flooding.

zh.s: 1953年1月31日星期六夜间至2月1日星期日清晨，一场强烈风暴引发北海大洪灾，荷兰、比利时、英格兰和苏格兰均遭波及。天文大潮与北海上空的强烈欧洲风暴叠加，形成风暴潮。强风、高潮位和低气压共同作用，使部分地点水位超过平均海平面5.6米（18.4英尺）。洪水和巨浪冲垮海防设施，造成大范围淹水。

en.s: On 31 January 1958 at about 10:48 p.m. Eastern Standard Time, Explorer 1 launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States, becoming the first successfully launched US satellite. Data from its cosmic-ray detector later contributed to the discovery of the Van Allen radiation belts.
en.n: January 31 is the local Eastern Standard Time launch date; it was February 1 in GMT. This records the launch, not a completed discovery or announcement of the radiation belts that same day.

zh.t: 美国首颗人造卫星“探索者1号”发射
zh.s: 1958年1月31日美国东部标准时间晚约10时48分，“探索者1号”从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射，成为美国首颗成功发射的人造卫星。其宇宙射线探测数据后来帮助科学家发现了范艾伦辐射带。
zh.n: 1月31日为发射地的美国东部标准时间，当时格林尼治时间已是2月1日。此条记录发射，不表示辐射带的发现或公布也在当天完成。

en.s: The 1965 Laotian coups were two separate coups that struck the Kingdom of Laos at the same time, on 31 January 1965. General Phoumi Nosavan, a participant in four prior coups, had been deprived of troop command as a result; nevertheless, he managed to come up with troops for another try at overthrowing the Royal Lao Government.

zh.s: 1965年1月31日，老挝王国同时发生两场各自独立的政变。富米·诺萨万将军此前曾参与四次政变，并因此被剥夺部队指挥权，但他仍设法调集军队，再次企图推翻老挝王国政府。

zh.s: 1967年1月31日，黑龙江红卫兵集会宣布成立革命委员会，该机构于同年3月改名为黑龙江省革命委员会。

en.s: The Tet Offensive was both a major escalation and one of the largest military campaigns of the Vietnam War. The North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Viet Cong (VC) launched a surprise attack on 30 and 31 January 1968 against the forces of the South Vietnamese Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN), the United States Armed Forces and their allies, targeting military and civilian command and control centers throughout South Vietnam.

zh.s: 春节攻势是越南战争中的一次重大升级，也是规模最大的军事行动之一。1968年1月30日至31日，越南人民军和越南南方民族解放阵线发动突然袭击，目标遍及南越各地的军政指挥中心，攻击对象包括越南共和国军、美国武装部队及其盟军。

en.t: Tet Offensive attack on the United States embassy
en.s: On 31 January 1968, a 15-man Viet Cong (VC) sapper team attempted to seize the embassy of the United States in Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, at the start of the VC's Tet Offensive. While the VC successfully penetrated the embassy compound, they were unable to enter the chancery building and were pinned down by security forces, with the three survivors eventually surrendering to US forces.

zh.t: 春节攻势期间袭击美国驻西贡大使馆
zh.s: 1968年1月31日，15名越南南方民族解放阵线的工兵试图攻占美国驻西贡大使馆。当时西贡是南越首都，这次袭击发生在春节攻势开始时。袭击者闯入大使馆院内，却未能进入办公楼，随后被安全部队困住。最终，3名幸存者向美军投降。

en.s: On 31 January 1968, Nauru became independent. Under the Nauru Independence Act 1967, Australia relinquished its authority over the island on the proclaimed independence day.

zh.s: 1968年1月31日，瑙鲁独立。根据《1967年瑙鲁独立法》，澳大利亚在指定的独立日放弃对瑙鲁的管辖权。

en.s: Apollo 14 was the eighth manned mission in the United States Apollo program, and the third to land on the Moon. It was the last of the "H missions," targeted landings with two-day stays on the Moon with two lunar EVAs, or moonwalks. Commander Alan Shepard, Command Module Pilot Stuart Roosa, and Lunar Module Pilot Edgar Mitchell launched on their nine-day mission on January 31, 1971 at 4:04:02 p.m. local time after a 40-minute, 2 second delay due to launch site weather restrictions, the first such delay in the Apollo program.

zh.s: 阿波罗14号是美国阿波罗计划第八次载人任务，也是第三次登月任务。它是最后一次H类任务，即在选定地点着陆、停留两天并进行两次月面舱外活动。指令长艾伦·谢泼德、指令舱驾驶员斯图尔特·鲁萨和登月舱驾驶员埃德加·米切尔，于当地时间1971年1月31日下午4时04分02秒升空，开始为期九天的任务。因发射场天气条件限制，发射推迟了40分02秒，这是阿波罗计划首次因天气出现此类延误。

en.s: The Laju incident, also known as the Laju ferry hijacking, occurred on 31 January 1974 in Singapore. Four armed men from the militant groups Japanese Red Army and Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine attacked the Shell oil refinery complex on Pulau Bukom and later hijacked the ferryboat Laju and took its five crew members hostage.

zh.s: 拉朱事件又称“拉朱号渡轮劫持事件”，于1974年1月31日在新加坡发生。日本赤军和巴勒斯坦解放人民阵线的四名武装人员袭击了武公岛的壳牌炼油厂，随后劫持拉朱号渡轮，并将船上五名船员扣为人质。

en.t: Holy Crown of Hungary goes on public display
en.s: On 31 January 1978, the Holy Crown of Hungary and the coronation regalia went on public display at the Hungarian National Museum in Hungary. They had been returned from the United States earlier that month.

en.s: The 1982 Charity Shield was the second and final Charity Shield (NSL), a soccer match played between the winners of the previous season's National Soccer League champion and NSL Cup winner. It took place at Richlands Stadium in Brisbane on 31 January 1982, between Sydney City and Brisbane Lions. Sydney City won 3–1, winning the final Charity Shield.

The Redskins defeated the Broncos by the score of 42–10, winning their second Super Bowl. The game was played on January 31, 1988, at Jack Murphy Stadium in San Diego, California, which was the first time that the Super Bowl was played there.

en.s: The United States invasion of Panama began in mid-December 1989 during the presidency of George H. W. Bush. The purpose of the invasion was to depose the de facto ruler of Panama, General Manuel Noriega, who was wanted by U.S. authorities for racketeering and drug trafficking. en.s: The Central Bank bombing was one of the deadliest terrorist attacks carried out by the LTTE during the Separatist civil war in Sri Lanka between the government and the Tamil Tigers.The attack took place on January 31, 1996, in the Sri Lankan city of Colombo. A truck (42-6452) containing about 440 pounds of high explosives crashed through the main gate of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, a seaside high-rise which managed most of the financial business of the country. As gunmen traded fire with security guards, the suicide bomber in the lorry detonated the massive bomb, which tore through the bank and damaged eight other buildings nearby .

en.s: General elections were held in Dominica on 31 January 2000 and saw the Dominica Labour Party led by Rosie Douglas take power defeating the previous government of the United Workers' Party led by Edison James, despite the UWP receiving more votes. en.s: Alaska Airlines Flight 261 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Licenciado Gustavo Díaz Ordaz International Airport in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico, to Seattle–Tacoma International Airport near Seattle, Washington, United States, with an intermediate stop at San Francisco International Airport in San Francisco, California. On January 31, 2000, the McDonnell Douglas MD-83 operating the flight crashed into the Pacific Ocean roughly 2.7 miles (4.3 km; 2.3 nmi) north of Anacapa Island, California, following a catastrophic loss of pitch control, while attempting to divert to Los Angeles International Airport.

en.s: An oil spill ignition occurred in Molo, Kenya, on January 31, 2009 and resulted in the deaths of at least 113 people and critical injuries to over 200 more. The incident occurred when an oil spill from an overturned truck burst into flames as onlookers attempted to obtain remnants of the spilled fuel for personal use. Rescuers suggested the cause to be static electricity, an accidentally-discarded cigarette, or an individual angered at a police blockade who sought vengeance. Police have described the carnage as Kenya's worst disaster in recent times, occurring in a country hit by frequent fuel shortages and just days after a supermarket fire killed 25.
